milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near and face the snow_block pillar placed above ground at spawn-relative [3, 1, -4] (confirmed by /setblock ~3 ~1 ~-4 minecraft:snow_block in scene commands). The pillar is ~5 blocks behind spawn, so the player needs to turn around briefly. max_distance=16 is generous enough that the player can trigger this from spawn position. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the snow_block pillar, confirming visual discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward and face the ocean (water body spanning Z+9 to Z+20, centered at spawn-relative [0, -1, 14]). The target Y=-1 matches the water surface level. max_distance=16 allows the player to trigger this from the shoreline (Z+7, about 7 blocks from target) or even from mid-snow-zone while facing forward. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the water body, confirming visual discovery of the ocean.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward and face the light_blue_concrete stepped pyramid structure on the far shore (spanning Z+23 to Z+26, X=-3 to X=3, up to Y+3, centered at spawn-relative [0, 1, 25]). max_distance=16 means the player can trigger this from the far beach (Z+21, ~4 blocks away) or from mid-ocean (Z+9+, within 16 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the concrete structure, confirming visual discovery.
